# PTokenV2 coupled candidate — NOT-QUALIFIED

`layouts.json` is separate from the historical 431-profile baseline and the
425-profile qualification cohort. It removes only root 5's legacy width-2
permission and adds the exact root-5 membership/root-6 enumerable operation
template. Balance, allowance, scalar and runtime/deployment fields are unchanged.
An independent membership path would bypass missing-set refusal and is forbidden.

`source-review.json` is generated by the host-only `prepare_ptoken_role` tool. It
rechecks the complete original capture against the preserved
[`ptoken-operation-proof`](../ptoken-operation-proof/) fixture, full fresh compiler
output and entire frozen Phase A report and compact operation transcripts. The
capture and runtime contain all 21 selected sources; 20 dependencies have exact
independent OpenZeppelin pins. The independent token repository remains unresolved.
No new source compilation or network/chain request is made by this preparer.

The semantics identifier `ptoken_v2_solc_0_8_28_oz_5_4_0` names the selected
compiler's reviewed ordered template. It does not qualify arbitrary OZ 5.4 builds.
Structural support is limited to Extended 4/5 with positive actual root-call begin
ordinals. Version 3 fallback is refused. Initial boolean/position/array coherence
and unused-tail-zero are qualification assumptions; no role cache or creation
seeding is introduced. Only source-executed equal zero-address append/tail-clear
stores may be absent. Real PToken producer visibility is still unqualified.

See the [focused candidate documentation](../../../docs/ptoken-coupled-role-candidate.md)
for operation ordering, synthetic controls, replay scope and remaining gates.
The Phase A proof remains a distinct immutable prerequisite, not a candidate
replay or deployment qualification.
